answer: EV charging-session signed meter proof: each charging session's metered kWh is signed by the charger operator and tied to a vehicle and a location, so an identity proves a real driver by presenting sessions across time. A basalt foundation of signed sessions cannot be faked cheaply, the tide of genuine charging rises and falls with real travel, and on the horizon of months of history a single driver emerges clearly, making mass Sybil creation uneconomic.
